properties.text: Ukrainian forces recently advanced in the Kupyansk, Novopavlivka, and Oleksandrivka directions.
ISW has observed evidence to assess that Russian forces seized 73.14 square kilometers and advanced and infiltrated into 104.44 square kilometers of Donetsk Oblast in August 2026.

Russian Subordinate Main Effort #3 – Donetsk Oblast Russian objective: Capture the entirety of Donetsk Oblast, the claimed territory of Russia’s proxies in Donbas, and advance into Dnipropetrovsk Oblast Ukrainian forces recently defeated a Russian infiltration mission in the Slovyansk direction.

Ukrainian forces captured Russian servicemembers during clearing operations in Mykolaivka (east of Slovyansk) according to geolocated footage published on September 1, indicating that Russian forces likely infiltrated Mykolaivka on a prior date.[32] Russian forces recently advanced in Kostyantynivka.

A Russian milblogger claimed on September 1 that Russian forces conducted ground operations in the Pokrovsk direction, but ISW has not observed evidence that Russian forces advanced.[36] Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Novopavlivka direction on September 1 and 2 but did not advance.[37] Neither Ukrainian nor Russian forces reported ground activity in the Oleksandrivka direction on September 2.

A Russian milblogger claimed on September 2 that elements of the Russian Eastern Grouping of Forces seized nine settlements in August 2026, including Liubytske, Zirnytsya, Nove Pole, Rybalske, Novosoloshyne, Zelene, Dolynka, Nizhenka, and Shevchenkivske (roughly between 5 and 18 kilometers from the closest assessed Russian advances).[40] ISW has not observed any evidence to support these claims at this time.
Russian forces seized 505.55 square kilometers in August 2025, for example, highlighting how Russian forces’ rate of advance continues to slow.

The Ukrainian General Staff reported on September 1 that Russian forces suffered 42,020 casualties in August 2026 — the second month in a row that Russian forces suffered over 40,000 casualties in a single month.[3] Russian forces suffered an average of 340 casualties per square kilometer of territory seized or infiltrated and 465 casualties per square kilometer seized in August 2026.

Ukrainian forces recently advanced in the Sumy, Borova, and Slovyansk directions and the Kostyantynivka-Druzhkivka tactical area, and Russian forces recently advanced in the Slovyansk direction and Kostyantynivka-Druzhkivka tactical area.

Russian forces conducted infiltration missions into Krasnyi Kut and Torske, according to geolocated footage published on August 31.[63] A Russian milblogger claimed that Russian forces advanced north of Novomykolaivka.[64] Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Dobropillya tactical area and the Pokrovsk, Novopavlivka, and Oleksandrivka directions on August 30 and 31 but did not advance.
